title: The 3-step system to automate your busywork with AI agents
idea: Small business owners lose hours every week to repetitive tasks. Teach a simple A.I.M. framework for handing one task to an AI agent.
hookLine: a week. That is what the average owner loses to work an AI agent could be doing right now.
credibility: We automated our own studio's admin before we ever sold this to a client.

steps.title: Aim
steps.point: Pick one task you repeat every single week. One.

steps.title: Instruct
steps.point: Describe the outcome you want, not every little step.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.point: Check its work weekly and tighten the instructions.

example: Our quote-and-invoice follow-ups now go out while we sleep.
ctaQuestion: Which task would you hand over first?
caption: Stop doing robot work. Hand ONE task to an AI agent this week using A.I.M. Which task are you picking? Tell me below.

title: Why your website gets traffic but no customers
idea: Traffic without conversions usually comes down to four fixable issues. Teach the FAST checklist for turning visitors into buyers.
hookLine: is all you get before a visitor decides if your business feels legit or not.
credibility: We rebuild websites for a living and these four fixes come up on almost every project.

steps.title: Fast
steps.point: If the page takes longer than 3 seconds, people leave.

steps.title: Answer
steps.point: Kill their objections right on the page. Price, trust, timing.

steps.title: Show
steps.point: Real photos, real reviews. Proof beats promises.

steps.title: Tell
steps.point: One page, one job. Say exactly what to do next.

example: One client doubled enquiries by just moving reviews above the fold.
ctaQuestion: Does your site pass the FAST check?
ctaOffer: Follow for a free site teardown every Friday.
caption: Your website has 3 seconds to prove your business is legit. Run the FAST check on yours today and thank me later.

title: How local businesses win customers with simple content
idea: You do not need to go viral, you need to be found by the right 500 locals. Teach the POST method for consistent local content.
hookLine: of people who search for a local service on their phone visit a business within a day.
credibility: This is the exact content plan we run for our own web design studio.

steps.title: Pick
steps.point: Choose one problem your customer actually googles.

steps.title: Offer
steps.point: Give one useful answer. No fluff, no hard sell.

steps.title: Show
steps.point: Prove it with a real example from your own work.

steps.title: Tag
steps.point: Name your city and your niche so the right people find it.

example: A plumber we know books most jobs from five simple how-to videos.
ctaQuestion: What does your ideal customer search for?
ctaOffer: Follow for one local marketing play every week.
caption: You don't need viral. You need the RIGHT 500 locals to know you exist. Run P.O.S.T. on your next piece of content.
